faction_archive.motif: The Archive, silent monastic archivists of the Severed Codex: an open book cut cleanly in two by a diagonal severing line, with a small key in the gutter, scholarly and austere

faction_choir.motif: Ascendant Choir, armed religious zealots of relic shrines: a tall pointed triple arch like a cathedral window with a halo of short rays above it, severe and devotional

faction_dmc.motif: Drift Miners Collective, blue-collar asteroid miners: a stylised pickaxe crossed with an orbital ring with two small moons on the ring, sturdy and working-class

faction_free.motif: Free Frontier, scattered independent waystations: an open compass rose whose outer ring is deliberately broken open on one side, hopeful and independent

faction_fulfillment.motif: The Fulfillment, clinical automaton administrators of fixed shipping routes: a perfect square set inside a circle with a single check mark and segmented barcode notches, sterile and geometric

faction_helix.motif: Helix Directorate, a bureaucracy of contract allocation, audits and paperwork: a double helix drawn as an official stamp seal with ledger lines across it, clerical and cold

faction_mts.motif: Meridian Trade Syndicate, a corporate trade syndicate of commodity exchanges and tolls: a circle bisected by a single meridian arc with fine tick marks and a small balance beam, corporate and precise

faction_pitborn.motif: The Pitborn, escaped scrappers of salvage yards and wreck fences: a patchwork gear ring stitched together from mismatched plates around a raised crowbar, defiant and scrappy

faction_quiet.motif: The Quiet, smugglers of black markets and contraband routes: a hushed closed-eye sigil, a narrow vertical slit inside a circle with two short sealing bars, secretive and minimal

faction_reach.motif: Crimson Reach, pirates of the lawless ambush lanes: a hooked boarding claw breaking through a cracked ring, aggressive and jagged

faction_scn.motif: Solar Concord Navy, the lawful federation navy of the core worlds and jump-gate checkpoints: a stern eight-point star over a sun disc, framed by a chevron-cut octagonal outline, naval and orderly

faction_understory.motif: The Understory, saprophyte scavengers of graveyard salvage and wreckage: a mushroom and mycelium network branching out of a broken hull fragment, organic and eerie

faction_vael.motif: The Vael, xenophobic aliens of the far rim with exotic technology: an asymmetric organic spiral thorn sigil, alien and unsettling, curved blades growing from a seed shape

faction_verge_layers.motif: The Verge-Layers, a nacre-shelled precursor intelligence of the jump-gate network: concentric nacre layers forming a gate ring, with an inward-curling spiral like a question mark at its centre, ancient and alien
